description:
Local-first MCP gateway. One port for every tool and every AI client.

Toolport is a local gateway that aggregates every MCP server on your machine and
shares them with every AI client you use, so a server is configured once rather
than once per client.

In lazy mode, Toolport exposes a small MCP tool catalog and discovers full tool
definitions on demand, which cuts context for clients that otherwise load every
tool definition. Servers, credentials, and access sets are managed in one app:
secrets live in the OS keychain, tool definitions are pinned and re-checked so a
changed tool is flagged (and quarantined in Strict mode), and destructive calls
can require human approval.

Runs entirely on your machine. There is no account, and no tool traffic leaves the
device unless a server you configured sends it.
